verdict.rationale: Mercury Books explicitly supports linking external bank accounts, cards, payroll platforms, and connects to third-party platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gusto, with transactions auto-categorized and reconciled in real time into the ledger. This directly matches the founder story of banking, payments, and payroll flowing automatically into the ledger. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and Mercury's own caveat that 'connected' isn't 'fully automated' tempers the completeness of the automation claim.
